title.en: Chapter 9 — The Red Sea and Beyond

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: The train left Bombay at night.
And in the compartment, Fogg and Passepartout, and a third man.

sentences.ar: ضابط إنجليزي طويل، السير فرانسيس كرومارتي.
sentences.en: A tall English officer, Sir Francis Cromarty.

sentences.ar: كان عالمونغوليا، ولعب ورق مع فوغ.
sentences.en: He had been on the Mongolia, and played cards with Fogg.

sentences.ar: وكان بيعرف الهند منيح، عاش فيها عشرين سنة.
sentences.en: And he knew India well, having lived there twenty years.
And he watched Fogg, and did not understand him.

sentences.ar: قال بقلبه: رجل بيلف حول الدنيا وما بيشوف منها شي.
sentences.en: He said to himself: a man going round the world and seeing nothing of it.
And Passepartout saw everything.

sentences.ar: من الشباك: الجبال، والغابات، والقرى، والقرود عالشجر.
sentences.en: From the window: mountains, forests, villages, monkeys in the trees.

sentences.ar: وكان يسأل السير فرانسيس عن كل شي.
sentences.en: And he asked Sir Francis about everything.
And in the morning, the train passed through a big forest.
And Passepartout remembered his watch.
It was still on London time.
And he refused to change it.
He said: the watch is right, and the sun is wrong.
And suddenly, the train stopped.
In the middle of the forest, at a small village.
And the conductor shouted: everyone out!
Fogg said: why?
The conductor said: the line ends here.
Sir Francis said: ends?
The papers said the line was complete!
The conductor said: the papers were wrong.

sentences.ar: في خمسين ميل ما اشتغلوا فيها.
sentences.en: There are fifty miles not built.
And the line continues on the other side.
Sir Francis was angry.
And Fogg said: I expected it.
Sir Francis said: expected it?
Fogg said: I expected some difficulty.
And I have two days in hand.

sentences.ar: الباخرة من كلكتا بتطلع 25 أكتوبر، الظهر.
sentences.en: The steamer from Calcutta leaves 25 October, at noon.
And today is the 22nd.
We will make it.

sentences.ar: والركاب التانيين ركضوا ياخدوا كل عربية وحصان بالقرية.
sentences.en: And the other passengers ran to take every cart and horse in the village.
And nothing was left for Fogg.
